title: mentha × rotundifolia var. insularis
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia var. insularis, commonly known as Corsican mint or insular mint, is a variety of the spearmint plant, known for its unique characteristics and distinct aroma. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing nausea and vomiting, alleviating digestive issues, and providing relief from headaches and fever. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × rotundifolia var. insularis include acting as a carminative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which contribute to its overall health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its distinct flavor and aroma, as well as its medicinal properties.
